event_summary: A tan stick attached to a black circular object sweeps leftward and the three right-side upright rectangular blocks fall over while the four left-side blocks remain upright.
raw_event_description: The scene begins with seven small upright rectangular blocks arranged in a row on a wooden tabletop, with a black circular object on the right. A tan stick connected near the top of the circular object becomes visible and changes orientation, sweeping toward the row of blocks. The stick reaches the rightmost block in the right-side group. The rightmost black block tilts and falls, followed by the adjacent white block and the adjacent black block in that group. Afterward, those three blocks lie on the tabletop, while the four blocks on the left remain upright.

reasons: The upright blocks, tabletop, circular object, and background wall are visible.
No block has started falling in the first frame.
The camera view includes the area where the later motion occurs.
